## Validation

- [ ] I ran `npm run validate`, or I listed the checks that I could not run.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] The change preserves public compatibility, or the pull request explains the migration.
- [ ] The change does not add credentials, customer data, instance URLs, or proprietary code.
- [ ] The change handles untrusted input and bounded resource use where applicable.

## Documentation and release notes

- [ ] I updated user documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I added a concise entry under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md` for a user-visible change.
